name: Three Dog, Galaxy News DJ
oracle_text: Whenever you attack, you may pay {2} and sacrifice an Aura attached to Three Dog. When you sacrifice an Aura this way, for each other attacking creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that Aura attached to that creature.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you attack, you may pay {2} and sacrifice an Aura attached to Three Dog. When you sacrifice an Aura this way, for each other attacking creature you control, create a token that's a copy of that Aura attached to that creature.

needs.what: copy_permanent taking an `attached_to` selector (as create_token already does for Roles), so a token copy of an Aura enters attached to a named host (303.4f), once per matching host inside a for_each over the other attacking creatures you control; plus a way for the `may` pay node's sacrifice cost to bind the sacrificed Aura (last-known information) so the reflexive trigger can name 'that Aura' as the copy source
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's options are amount, as, attacking, controller, except, objects, or_planeswalker, tapped: no attached_to, so the copy would enter unattached; copy_permanent followed by attach is the pattern the reference explicitly forbids for attached tokens (the Aura enters with no host). create_token has attached_to but only makes ids in token_ids, never a copy of an arbitrary Aura. The sacrificed Aura is in the graveyard by the time the reflexive trigger resolves, and no cost key records which permanent a `may` pay sacrifice took
